description: TOGAF Architecture Development Method (ADM) evidence registry for the arckit-togaf-adm plugin. Registry-driven: 12 ADM codes map to the plugin's 12 command files; no bundled JSON/YAML schemas — tools validate structure against the registry itself.

codes.description: Preparation for the ADM — determine scope, stakeholders, constraints
Discover strategic business drivers, candidate architecture principles, and the architecture approach
Business Capability Map — capability hierarchy, maturity levels, ownership
Application inventory — catalogue of application assets, lifecycles, owners
Application rationalization — consolidate, retire, re-platform decisioning
Capability-matrix gap analysis, severity scoring, workstream mapping
Transition architecture — work packages, milestones, migration sequencing
Architecture Board governance — review cadence, decision log, exception tracking
Architecture change management — change control, impact analysis, disposition
Architecture repository — artifact inventory, versioning, traceability links
Data architecture — data domain, flow, lineage, data-quality evidence
Technology architecture — platform, infrastructure, integration, deployment

tools.name: togaf_check_code_coverage
tools.description: Validate that an architecture evidence report covers the required TOGAF ADM codes. Checks that the report lists every mandatory code, that each cited code exists in the registry, and that no unknown code ids are used. Returns valid, missing, unknown, and coverage_report.

codes.description: List of ADM code ids (e.g. BIZ-CAP-MAP, GAP-ANALYSIS) that the evidence report claims to cover.

mandatory.description: Subset of code ids that must appear; defaults to the two architecture-phase codes that most TOGAF ADM evidence checks require.

tools.name: togaf_check_transition_plan
tools.description: Check a TOGAF transition-architecture plan for structural completeness: every work package must have an id, name, and capability it closes; every capability must trace to a gap-analysis code. Returns valid, problems, work_packages, gap_trace.

work_packages.description: List of transition work-package objects; each must carry id, name, and closes (a capability id).

capability_gaps.description: Capability gap ids that the plan claims to close.
